name: Entity UUID Lookup
description: provides an admin form, toolbar item and navigation block to enter an entity UUID and be redirected to its canonical/edit URL.
project_description:
This module provides an admin form, toolbar button and navigation block that allow you to enter any entity UUID and be redirected to its canonical or edit URL. The admin form is accessible through an admin menu link, an admin toolbar item and (for the Navigation module) a navigation block.

 

 Post-Installation 
 The admin page is accessible for anyone with the 'Lookup entities by UUID' and 'View the administration theme' permissions, so make sure to grant these to the required roles. The toolbar button, navigation block and admin menu link will be visible once this is done.
